declarations.name: centered_bounded_mgf
declarations.sourceMeaning: Actual centered bounded real f under arbitrary measurable probability nu; actual second-moment integral <=v; derive exp integrability and mgf(t)<=exp(t^2*v) when abs(t)*B<=1.
declarations.proofRoute: Original complex exponential quadratic remainder; legitimate integrable polynomial comparison; actual mean zero; actual second moment; 1+s<=exp(s).

declarations.name: finite_iid_variance_sensitive_tail
declarations.sourceMeaning: Same actual finite Pi(nu) observations and actual f; measurable STRICT absolute excess event at 2sqrt(card*v*q)+2Bq; real probability <=2exp(-q).
declarations.proofRoute: Actual Pi coordinate independence and map laws; independent mgf finite product; d=sqrt(aq)+Bq,t=q/d on B>0,q>0; tB<=1,t^2a<=q; positive/negative Chernoff and union.
